# Orbit Dock — Project Overview & Changelog

- **Project ID**: `orbit-dock`
- **Category**: Systems
- **Current Version**: 2026 · v1.4

## Overview
Orbit Dock solves context fragmentation for solo builders. Instead of scattering bookmarks and markdown notes across folders, Orbit Dock indexes project directories and surfaces active blockers alongside recent commits.

## Verified Highlights
- Reduced project context-switching latency by 38% in a 22-participant diary study
- Zero-cloud local indexing engine with deterministic snapshot diffs
- Keyboard-first command palette with instant file preview

# Fieldnotes Studio

Fieldnotes Studio links timestamped interview transcripts directly to affinity clusters, so every theme in a research readout can be traced back to the exact quote it came from.

## Release notes
Version 1.0 shipped in November 2026 after a three-month beta with campus research teams.

## Highlights
- Verifiable quote-to-theme provenance links across 60+ hours of interviews
- Exportable markdown evidence briefs for product stakeholders
- Privacy-preserving local transcript redaction pipeline
